title: 5-bromo-2-deoxyuridine \(BrdU) and 7-amino-actinomycin \(7-AAD) staining for cell proliferation assay
protocol: Inject 1 mg of BrdU, dissolved in 300 μl PBS, into the peritoneal cavity 12 hours before analysis.
Harvest splenocytes by grinding spleens in RPMI-1640 medium between two frosted microscope slides.
Spin cells at 1000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Remove erythrocytes by adding one equivalent volume of ACK Lysing Buffer to the remaining pellet.
Gently resuspend, swirl tube for 1 minute.
Fill tube with 10 ml of RPMI-1640, centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in 10 ml of RPMI-1640.
Filter through a 70 μm nylon cell strainer.
Centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Resuspend 1 x 10^7 cells in 500 μl of FACS buffer.
Obtain B cells by CD43 negative purification using anti-CD43 magnetic beads.
Wash and resuspend 1x10^6 splenic B cells in 500 μl of 0.5% paraformaldehyde in PBS.
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes (fixation).
Spin and wash once with PBS.
Spin and resuspend in 1 ml of freshly made 3 N HCl/0.5% Tween 20.
Incubate at 25°C for 20 minutes.
Spin and resuspend in 1 ml of 0.1 M disodium tetraborate.
Spin and wash with FACS buffer.
Stain with FITC-labeled anti-BrdU.
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes.
Spin and resuspend cells in 500 μl FACS buffer containing 2.0 μl of 7-AAD solution.
Analyze 10 min later.
Gate on the proper populations on forward scatter versus side scatter.
